MODULE.title: M21 · Core HR & Lifecycle
MODULE.desc: Employee directory and record, org chart and positions, hire and onboarding, transfer and promotion, exit and settlement, movement history, appointment letters, service books, dependants and nominees, and ESS/MSS self-service.

sections.title: Identity
sections.note: The employee master is the HR anchor; payroll reference is the code, and the position links the person to the establishment register.

sections.title: Employee
sections.note: Creating the employee record is the hire; the employment contract (Hire / Onboard) carries the Labour Act terms and the probation window.

sections.title: Contract
sections.note: Joining date, contract type and basic salary; probation may not exceed six months (Labour Rules 2021 r.25) and the legal-signoff state gates activation.

sections.title: Movement
sections.note: Draft → approved → applied. Applying moves the employee's current position and branch; the movement history reads these records. A promotion is the same record with movement_type promotion.

sections.title: Exit
sections.note: Every clearance line must be ticked before the exit can be cleared; settlement is the final amount recorded by payroll.

sections.title: Document
sections.note: Appointment letter, ID card, service book or experience certificate — the Labour Act document register.

sections.title: Dependant
sections.note: Nominee share is a 0–100 percentage (database CHECK).

sections.title: Organisation Position
sections.note: A seat in the organisation chart; headcount and approval routing hang off it.

sections.title: Leave Type
sections.note: Opened from the module's own record set. Every field here is the model's real field; the workflow rules live on the model and are not bypassed by this form.

MODULE.title: M22 · Learning & Certification
MODULE.desc: Competency framework, skill matrix and assessments, the certification register with validity and renewal, dispatch eligibility with a hard block on expired certification, the course catalogue and learning paths, schedule/attendance, OJT mentoring, and ISO/brand audit evidence.

sections.title: Certification
sections.note: Status is computed from the expiry date; an expired certification is what blocks a technician from dispatch on that competency.

sections.title: Course
sections.note: A course certifies towards one competency; the catalogue is what learning paths and enrolments reference.

sections.title: Learning Path
sections.note: A path names the target role, the target competencies and the courses that build them, with the minimum level expected.

sections.title: Assessment
sections.note: Score is a 0–100 percentage (database CHECK); the level is the independent judgement the skill matrix reads.

sections.title: On-the-Job Training
sections.note: Mentoring record with hours and outcome; the training-hours KPI divides total OJT hours by technicians.

sections.title: Evidence
sections.note: Draft → submitted → accepted; only submitted evidence can be accepted.

sections.title: Competency
sections.note: A competency definition with its proficiency ladder; training and appraisal read it.

sections.title: Training Enrolment
sections.note: An employee's enrolment in a session; completion updates the competency evidence.

MODULE.title: M55 · Time, Attendance & Scheduling
MODULE.desc: Biometric and geofenced capture, exception regularisation, working-time rules and overtime, moon-dependent holidays, leave requests and balances, shift patterns, rosters and publication, on-call standby, and availability published to dispatch.

sections.title: Leave Request
sections.note: Days compute from the date range; an approved request marks the roster slot as on-leave so dispatch does not schedule the technician.

sections.title: Roster
sections.note: One employee, one date, one shift. The roster is the real availability answer used by dispatch.

sections.title: Shift
sections.note: Start/end hours are decimal (9.5 = 09:30) and must lie inside a 24-hour day.

sections.title: Punch
sections.note: A manual or flagged punch stays recorded until a supervisor approves or rejects it; only an approved punch counts as worked time.

sections.title: Holiday
sections.note: Moon-dependent holidays are tentative until the sighting is announced; one record per date per company.

sections.title: On-Call
sections.note: Planned → active → completed; the end cannot precede the start (database CHECK).

sections.title: Biometric Device
sections.note: A biometric attendance terminal: its serial, location and the sync state of its punches.

sections.title: Attendance Lock
sections.note: Opened from the module's own record set. Every field here is the model's real field; the workflow rules live on the model and are not bypassed by this form.

MODULE.title: M56 · Payroll & Statutory
MODULE.desc: BD gross-to-net engine, income tax AY 2026-27, provident fund, gratuity, festival bonus, BEFTN bank files, payslips and certificates, quarterly withholding returns and final settlements.

sections.title: Structure
sections.note: Percentages are of gross and must lie in 0–100; PF and gratuity applicability decide which statutory lines the payslip calculates.

sections.title: Payroll Period
sections.note: Draft → attendance locked → calculated → approved → paid → posted. The calculator refuses a period whose attendance is not locked.

sections.title: Festival Bonus
sections.note: The bonus is a multiplier on basic or gross; approving commits it and paying closes it.

sections.title: Settlement / Off-Cycle
sections.note: An off-cycle payment records arrears, advances, adjustments or a part of the final settlement; the Labour Act gratuity itself is computed by the payslip separation action.

sections.title: Off-Cycle
sections.note: Draft → approved → paid; a cancelled payment stays recorded.

sections.title: Certificate
sections.note: Salary, tax-deduction or employment certificate for one employee and fiscal year.

sections.title: Quarterly Return
sections.note: Filing records the NBR acknowledgement and the date.

MODULE.title: M57 · Performance & Incentives
MODULE.desc: Goal cascades and KPI definitions, review cycles with calibration, performance improvement plans, technician incentive schemes and calculation runs, recognition awards, compensation review against bands, and succession planning.

sections.title: Goal
sections.note: A goal cascades from a parent goal and carries a 0–100 weight; closing it compares actual against target and records achieved or missed.

sections.title: Review Cycle
sections.note: Manager review needs a manager rating; calibration defaults to the manager rating unless changed; only a calibrated review closes.

sections.title: Incentive Run
sections.note: A run fixes the period and the band base; its lines are computed from the technician scorecards.

sections.title: Recognition
sections.note: Spot, monthly, quarterly or values award with its citation and prize.

sections.title: Improvement Plan
sections.note: End cannot precede start (CHECK); closing requires an outcome.

sections.title: Succession
sections.note: Key position, incumbent, ready successor and the readiness window.

sections.title: Compensation Band
sections.note: A pay band for a grade; offers are validated against the band it belongs to.

MODULE.title: M58 · Talent Acquisition
MODULE.desc: Requisitions against budget, job postings, the candidate pipeline, structured interviews, practical assessments, reference and background checks, offers, pre-boarding and first-90-days reviews.

sections.title: Requisition
sections.note: A requisition names the position and the number of openings; opening it is the budget approval point in this model.

sections.title: Candidate
sections.note: Name, contact and the requisition applied for; the stage carries the pipeline.

sections.title: Structured Interview
sections.note: Score is 0–5 (CHECK); completing the interview requires a recommendation.

sections.title: Offer
sections.note: Draft → issued → accepted/declined; accepting the offer moves the candidate to Hired.

sections.title: Check
sections.note: Reference, NID, education, employment or police check; marking clear records the completion date.

sections.title: Review
sections.note: Milestone check (day 30/60/90) with a 0–5 rating.

sections.title: Onboarding Plan
sections.note: A pre-boarding plan: the tasks that must complete before the joining date.

sections.title: Talent Assessment
sections.note: Opened from the module's own record set. Every field here is the model's real field; the workflow rules live on the model and are not bypassed by this form.

MODULE.title: M59 · Health, Safety & Wellbeing
MODULE.desc: Hazard register with risk scoring, JSA and safe procedures, PPE register, incident and near-miss reporting, investigation and RCA, the statutory DIFE notification clock, lone-worker check-ins, road and vehicle safety, battery/electrical/chemical risks, drills and training, the safety committee and occupational health with return-to-work.

sections.title: Incident
sections.note: Report the incident with its type and severity; high severity means critical/hospitalisation/DIFE-reportable and starts the statutory clock.

sections.title: Incident Report
sections.note: Reported → investigating → action taken → closed. High severity is the DIFE-reportable band.

sections.title: Job Safety Analysis
sections.note: Steps, hazards and controls per step, plus the PPE required; approving stamps the date.

sections.title: PPE Item
sections.note: The register holds PPE item types with their regulatory standard and stock; issuing to a worker records the item type and standard.

sections.title: Occupational Health
sections.note: Fitness outcome drives the return-to-work decision; restrictions are recorded verbatim.

sections.title: Hazard
sections.note: Risk score is likelihood × severity (both 1–5, CHECK); residual risk is the judgement after controls.

sections.title: Drill
sections.note: Completing a drill stamps the date; participants and findings are recorded for the coverage pack.

sections.title: Lone Worker Check-in
sections.note: A lone-worker check-in record; a missed check-in raises the HSE alert.

sections.title: Road Check
sections.note: A vehicle road-worthiness check with the defects found and the action taken.

sections.title: Hazardous Substance Register
sections.note: The hazardous-substance register entry (battery/chemical): quantity, storage and disposal route.

fields.name: un_number
fields.label: UN Transport Number (e.g. UN 1219 for IPA, UN 3481 for Li-Ion)

sections.title: Safety Committee
sections.note: A safety committee with its members, meeting cadence and the minutes reference.

sections.title: Safety Inspection
